title: An erase in the same frame as a chat reveal goes back twice, one history entry too far
evidence: Found while settling H129 (PR 1779). With a value page open, a chat reveal renders and schedules its drop effect (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:117-122, at main abebcbce4). If an erase event lands before that effect runs, the open page's erase listener (:108) calls drop(), which calls window.history.back() because onPageEntry() is true (:64-68). The reveal effect then calls drop() again. history.back() is async, so the page entry is still current and onPageEntry() is still true, and the second drop() goes back again. The page can land one entry before My data's own. Reproduced in a hook test of about 40 lines: a harness renders useValuePage with a page open, and a useLayoutEffect in the reveal's commit dispatches DRAFTS_CLEARED_EVENT before the reveal's passive effect runs. history.back is spied on and passed through to jsdom's real history. It counts 2 backs where 1 is right. A prototype of H129's reveal event gives the same 2, so that remedy does not fix this. Remedy idea: guard drop() with a back already pending, so a second drop() before the popstate arrives does not go back again.
